facts.fact: The US Country Commercial Guide, dated 2026-02-10, anchors Mauritania's state-led digital push in the National Digital Transformation Agenda (2022-2025), a period that had ended by the guide's date, and says further backbone build-out is signalled beyond 2025; it names no successor agenda.

systems.tiers: national; guide lists fibre backbone, 4G and e-government as its content

systems.country_label: plan stratégique 2023-2026 of the Autorité de Protection des Données

note: The guide calls the agenda the anchor of a state-led digital push (backbone, 4G, e-government) but does not otherwise describe its scope, so class is left empty; the period fact is recorded with class empty.
